summary.value: No significant strength of the paper was recognized by the reviewers. I recommend rejecting this paper.

reviewer_concerns.value:
* Although Reviewer qXRg gave a positive score, no significant technical details or evidence were presented to support accepting this paper. 

* Both Reviewer qXRg and m7Sg pointed out that the judge model (Qwen3-8B) is not sufficient. 

* Although Reviewer m7Sg also gave a positive score, the mentioned single strength is about the high-level direction of the work. On the other hand, the reviewer raised many detailed issues, and some of them were not perfectly resolved by the authors.
